cause: Test harness DevTools relay exceeded 104857600 byte pending-read limit while base64-transferring the 89117001 byte model. Browser log: Too large read data is pending; Connection closed, not enough capacity.
mitigation: Model files are streamed by a local HTTP mirror rather than sent in a DevTools route.fulfill body. CLIP-only retry succeeded twice; see benchmark-slot.json. The client also retains one-model-per-worker isolation.
